name: kettlebell incline fly
description: A fly on an incline bench using kettlebells. It stretches and works the upper chest.
instructions: Lie on an incline bench holding a kettlebell in each hand above your chest.
Keep a soft bend in the elbows.
Open your arms wide in an arc until you feel a chest stretch.
Squeeze the chest to bring the weights back together.
Control the weights and keep your wrists stable.
